# Data Source: okta_collections_assignment

Lists every assignment of a resource [Collection](https://developer.okta.com/docs/api/iga/openapi/governance.api/tag/Collections/). The API returns the most recently assigned principals first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okta_collections_assignment" "example" {
  collection_id = "col1example2AbCdE1d7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) Unique identifier for the collection.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Ignored; always set to `okta_collections_assignment_list`.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Block List) The collection's assignments (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--items)).

<a id="nestedblock--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `actor` (String) The flow that triggered the grant request, for example `API` or `ACCESS_REQUEST`.
- `assignment_type` (String) Collection assignment type or source, for example `INDIVIDUAL`.
- `expiration_time` (String) The RFC 3339 date and time at which the principal's access expires. Unset for indefinite access.
- `id` (String) The item's position in the list (`"0"`, `"1"`, …). This is not the assignment ID.
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone for `expiration_time`.

~> **Note:** `items` contains only the first page returned by the API, and does not include the assignment ID or the principal.
